displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-023: Lateral movement chain — Admin Tool Abuse → Credential Dump → Lateral Spread
description:
Detects legitimate admin tool abuse followed by credential dumping and lateral movement across hosts

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: lateral movement chain — admin tool abuse → creden

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_023", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
